existing.description: The Temasek Undergraduate Overseas Scholarship is awarded to exceptional polytechnic graduates who show academic excellence, outstanding extracurricular involvement and a strong passion for STEM, to study a STEM undergraduate degree at an overseas university, with Medicine and Dentistry excluded. Temasek lists tuition and other compulsory fees for the whole course, a monthly living allowance, one-time relocation and pre-studies allowances, reimbursed application fees for up to five universities and visa fees, plus exchange programmes, internships and mentoring. Eligibility is capped by a Gross Monthly Household Income of S$15,000 or less at the point of admission, and graduates must serve a 4-year bond in a STEM-related role in Singapore or with a Singapore-headquartered company.
eligibility: Be a local polytechnic graduate, or be graduating from a local polytechnic
Be accepted or planning to enrol in a STEM undergraduate course at an overseas university, excluding Medicine and Dentistry
Have a Gross Monthly Household Income of S$15,000 or less at the point of admission
Demonstrate commitment to contributing to the STEM economy in Singapore
Academic excellence, outstanding extracurricular involvement and a strong passion for STEM fields
Applications may be submitted before final cumulative GPA and examination results are received
existing.eligibility_summary: Singapore Citizens who are a local polytechnic graduate or are graduating from a local polytechnic, accepted or planning to enrol in a STEM undergraduate course at an overseas university, excluding Medicine and Dentistry, with a Gross Monthly Household Income of S$15,000 or less at the point of admission, and who demonstrate a commitment to contributing to the STEM economy in Singapore. Interested polytechnic students are encouraged to apply before commencing their undergraduate degree.

Consolidate the supporting documents into a single file for upload under CV submission
Declare Gross Monthly Household Income in the application
If shortlisted, complete the online assessment and video interview
If shortlisted, attend the one-day in-person group assessment
If selected as a final candidate, attend a 60-minute structured interview
existing.selection_notes: Shortlisted applicants complete an online psychometric and personality assessment and a remote, on-demand video interview evaluating general abilities, motivations, interests and values, followed by a one-day in-person group assessment of leadership, agility, teamwork and critical thinking, and finally a 60-minute structured interview for final candidates. A provisional scholarship offer may be extended to a suitable applicant, subject to confirmation on release of the final cumulative GPA, examination results and acceptance into an overseas university. Applicants who will be enlisting for National Service may apply, and preliminary polytechnic diploma results may be submitted.
existing.best_fit: Singapore Citizen polytechnic graduates or final-year polytechnic students from households with a Gross Monthly Household Income of S$15,000 or less, strong STEM passion and academic results, who intend to read a STEM undergraduate degree at an overseas university and will work in a STEM-related role in Singapore or a Singapore-headquartered company afterwards.
existing.notes: The award is means-tested through the Gross Monthly Household Income cap of S$15,000 at the point of admission, and excludes Medicine and Dentistry. Temasek publishes no monetary amounts for the tuition, living, relocation, pre-studies, application or visa components on this page, so no funding figure is recorded. The scholarship is part of Temasek's T-Spring community gift and sits under the Temasek Scholarship family alongside the Temasek Undergraduate Local Scholarship. Note that the page's own text says the AY2026/2027 window "is now open" while the closing date it gives, 15 September 2026, had already passed as at this verification date, so the page text appears not to have been refreshed after the extension lapsed.
existing.duration: Over the course of the undergraduate study at the overseas university; the official page does not state a fixed number of years
existing.application_period: A fixed annual window. The published Academic Year 2026/2027 window opened on 1 July 2026 and was extended to 15 September 2026, and the page states applications may be submitted before final cumulative GPA and examination results are received.
